title: Sheep and road
description: Help small defenseless sheep to find back their home. Among all these roads and intersections, they are completely lost. On their way, they are not alone... wolves are waiting to devour them. Protect all sheep by managing their moves. If a sheep is devoured, the game is over. The sheep community thanks you for your help.
